inlineQuestionInput.control: dedicated single-line TextBox below the independent status/replay strip
inlineQuestionInput.hint: 输入问题，按 Enter 提问
inlineQuestionInput.enter: reuses question.open then question.submit; accepted input produces exactly one common task.submit
inlineQuestionInput.blank: no semantic action and no IPC
inlineQuestionInput.escape: clear locally, emit no command, restore WS_EX_NOACTIVATE
inlineQuestionInput.submissionResult: clear only after accepted submission; preserve original text after failure
inlineQuestionInput.focus: on direct click, temporarily remove WS_EX_NOACTIVATE and activate the TextBox; on submit, Escape, or focus loss, restore no-activate and the prior foreground window when valid
